summary: The Manager is noticeably faster on Home, Jobs, Commit and Audit, and large reads from Microsoft are throttled less.

fixes.title: Home and Jobs load much faster
fixes.text: Home now loads in 1 to 3 seconds instead of 4 to 6, and the Jobs page in about 0.7 seconds.

fixes.title: Recent changes on Commit appear instantly
fixes.text: The recent configuration changes on the Commit page now load in a quarter of a second instead of about seven.

fixes.title: The Audit tab is faster
fixes.text: The Audit tab reads the before and after details only for the entries on screen, so it is about a third faster.

fixes.title: Fewer slow-downs from Microsoft on large reads
fixes.text: When Microsoft starts slowing PIM Manager down, it now asks for less at a time. Large reads hit far fewer limits and finish sooner.
